quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on managing his spending compared to Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: He's got a lot more money than me so I got to make sure I level out

text_blocks.speaker: Jared McCain
text_blocks.text: He's got a lot more money than me so I got to make sure I level out the spending. If he spends a million, I can only spend like 20,000. So I just got to make sure I'm aware of that.

quotes.speaker: Chet Holmgren
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren on the true purpose of wearing a luxury watch
quotes.excerpt: You don't wear a watch to tell the time. You wear a watch to tell people your time
quotes.quote: In today's age, you don't wear a watch to tell the time. You wear a watch to tell people that your time is valued.
